Card Q&A.a: Yes, it can. This card's [When Digivolving] effect affects "all of your opponent's Digimon," therefore it will also apply to opponent's Digimon that are newly played until the end of their turn.
Card Q&A.q: This Digimon has [Leon Alexander] in its digivolution cards, and I activated its [When Digivolving] effect. Can it give  to my opponent's Digimon that are played into the battle area afterward?
If I have exactly 3 cards in my security stack, do I activate both the "1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -6000 DP" effect and  when activating this card's [End of Your Turn] effect?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can. Once the [End of Your Turn] effect activates, you can perform the part of the effect after "then" regardless of the number of security cards.
Card Q&A.q: When I have 3 security cards, can I use this card's [End of Your Turn] effect to gain  and then use 1 of my Digimon to attack an opponent's Digimon if my security stack increases to 4 cards?

Effect: [When Digivolving] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon. If [Leon Alexander] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, all of your opponent's Digimon gain ＜Security A. -1＞ until the end of their turn.

[End of Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] If you have 3 or more security cards, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -6000 DP for the turn. If you have 3 or fewer, ＜Recovery +1 (Deck)＞. Then, 1 of your Digimon may attack an opponent's Digimon.
Inherited Effect: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When a card is removed from your security stack, if this Digimon has [Fenriloogamon] in its name, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -8000 DP for the turn.
